capabilities: pair mobile devices over the local network with no IP, port, PIN or key entry
incrementally sync any file type between a desktop server and mobile clients
merge conflicting edits three-way and flag overlapping lines as colored callouts
authorize and revoke device tokens from the desktop
exclude paths from syncing via an editable blacklist
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Tested only on Windows desktop + Android; iOS untested. Distributed via GitHub Releases with no build step. Limitations: same LAN only, no encryption, no full version history, files over 2 MB are not merged.
problem: Syncing a vault between desktop and mobile normally requires a cloud account, paid service, or manual IP and key setup, and local-only options are missing.
summary: LAN-only two-way vault sync with zero-input pairing; the desktop serves the vault over HTTP and phones or tablets sync as clients.
